senses.gloss: f. (פטל, v. preced.) wickerwork, esp. a sort of bale for packing dates, figs &c.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 12:15">Tosef. Sabb. XII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 13:15">XIII</cite>), 15 <he>פ׳ של גרוגרות מקרע וכ׳</he> you may cut open a bale of figs (on the Sabbath) and eat; Y. ib. XV, beg. 15ᵃ <cite ref="Q00514"><he>פטילייא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 16:5">Kel. XVI, 5</cite> <cite ref="Q00532"><he>פְּטַלְיָה</he></cite> ed. Dehr. (ed. <cite ref="Q00514"><he>פּטילייה</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 1:2:3">Y. Maas. Sh. I, 52ᵈ</cite> <he>פטולייא של תמרים</he> a bale of dates, contrad. fr. <cite ref="H00496"><he>חוֹתָל</he></cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>פְּטַלְיָאוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ma'aser Sheni 1:10">Tosef. Maas. Sh. I, 10</cite> <he>פ׳ ודרוסות של תמרה</he> ed. Zuck. (ed. omit <he>פ׳</he>) dates packed in bales, and date pomaces.
